resources.string: With a keyboard, press Left and Right arrow together to turn arrow key navigation on or off. While it\'s on, the arrow keys run commands, as in VoiceOver on iOS. Change each arrow key\'s command under Settings, Keyboard shortcuts.

Next track and Previous track control media, and can be assigned to gestures or keys under Settings, Commands. The Sound mode reading control switches between Sound, Vibrate and Mute; add it under Settings, Reading controls.

Every speech input in SandFly now uses SandFly\'s dictation: Dictate, questions about images and the screen, and voice commands. Under Settings, Typing, Dictation, choose the speech recognition, such as Google on-device, Rambler or Whisper, and whether AI corrects the text. Auto stop after silence ends recording after a pause you choose.

SandFly Pro is a paid add-on. Its AI agent operates apps for you, including apps and games that don\'t work with screen readers, and runs SandFly commands, such as changing the speech rate. Assign Start or stop AI agent task to a gesture or key under Settings, Commands, then say or type the task. A safety check asks before sensitive actions, and in banking apps the agent only reads. SandFly Pro is also an AI service for image and screen descriptions and live recognition, with no API key. Buy a code or enter one under Settings, SandFly Pro.

Each setting is now on the screen named after what it changes, and the main screen is shorter. Commands lists every command with its gestures and keyboard shortcut, and assigns them in one place. Reading controls and SandFly menu list their current items in order, to move or remove.

SandFly can translate what it says. Assign Translate last spoken phrase to a gesture or key under Settings, Commands. Under Settings, Translation, choose the service and the languages, and turn on Automatic translation of speech in another language, or translation of notifications. On-device translation downloads each language once and then works offline.
A new tutorial teaches SandFly step by step: you try each gesture, and SandFly checks it and says what happened. Open it under Settings, Help and feedback, SandFly tutorial.
SandFly 0.2.0 has the new features on the following pages. To read them again later, open New features in SandFly at the top of SandFly settings.
